title: Physics-Informed and Hybrid Machine Learning in Additive Manufacturing: Application to Fused Filament Fabrication
abstract: arXiv:2608.17246v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This article investigates several physics-informed and hybrid machine learning strategies that incorporate physics knowledge in experimental data-driven deep-learning models for predicting the bond quality and porosity of fused filament fabrication (FFF) parts. Three types of strategies are explored to incorporate physics constraints and multi-physics FFF simulation results into a deep neural network (DNN), thus ensuring consistency with physical laws: (1) incorporate physics constraints within the loss function of the DNN, (2) use physics model outputs as additional inputs to the DNN model, and (3) pre-train a DNN model with physics model input-output and then update it with experimental data. These strategies help to enforce a physically consistent relationship between bond quality and tensile strength, thus making porosity predictions physically meaningful. translated_title: 物理信息与混合机器学习在增材制造中的应用：以熔融丝材制造为例
translated_abstract: 本文研究了多种物理信息和混合机器学习策略，这些策略将物理知识融入基于实验数据的深度学习模型中，用于预测熔融丝材制造（FFF）零件的粘接质量和孔隙率。探索了三种策略，将物理约束和多物理场FFF模拟结果整合到深度神经网络（DNN）中，从而确保与物理定律的一致性：（1）在DNN的损失函数中纳入物理约束，（2）将物理模型输出作为DNN模型的额外输入，（3）使用物理模型输入-输出预训练DNN模型，然后用实验数据更新它。这些策略有助于在粘接质量和拉伸强度之间建立物理一致的关系，从而使孔隙率预测具有物理意义。研究了上述策略的八种不同组合。结果...
tldr: 本文提出并评估了三种物理信息与混合机器学习策略，将物理约束和模拟数据融入深度学习模型，以增强FFF增材制造中粘接质量和孔隙率预测的物理一致性和准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes and evaluates three physics-informed and hybrid machine learning strategies that integrate physics constraints and simulation data into deep learning models to enhance the physical consistency and accuracy of bond quality and porosity predictions in FFF additive manufacturing.
